references_experience.text: en s strani končnega naročnika (uporabnika) referenčnega posla. Referenčni posli morajo biti potrjeni s strani pristojne osebe. Pristojna oseba za podpis je bodisi zakoniti zastopnik oziroma oseba, ki razpolaga s pooblastilom za zastopanje gospodarskega subjekta oziroma oseba, ki ima pooblastilo za podpis potrdila, oziroma potrdilo podpiše oseba, ki je v delovni organizaciji pooblaščena za vodenje sektorja, kjer je bil referenčni projekt izveden. Dokazila morajo biti v slovenskem jeziku (ali prevedena v slovenski jezik). (Ponudnik lahko pogoj izpolni s partnerjem ali podizvajalcem, če bodo slednji prevzeli dela na projektu za katere podajajo reference.) 2.2. Ponudnik mora v ponudbi nominirati tehnične strokovnjake, ki bodo sodelovali pri izvajanju predmeta javnega naročila: - vsaj en certificiran svetovalec za ponujeno rešitev: ki je zadnjih 5 letih pred objavo obvestila o naročilu kot svetovalec sodeloval pri implementaciji vsaj dveh PPM/SPM rešitev, ki kumulativno zagotavlja upravljanje strategije, projektov, portfeljev, virov in poročanje ki razpolaga z veljavnih certifikatom proizvajalca ponujene rešitve (kopija certifikata se preloži v ponudbi) - vodjo projekta: ki razpolaga z veljavnim mednarodno priznanim certifikatom s področja projektnega, programskega ali portfeljskega upravlj

veljavnega certifikata se preloži v ponudbi) ki je zadnjih 5 letih pred objavo obvestila o naročilu kot vodja projekta sodeloval pri implementaciji vsaj dveh PPM/SPM rešitev, ki kumulativno zagotavlja upravljanje strategije, projektov, portfeljev, virov in poročanje - tehničnega strokovnjaka: ki je zadnjih 5 letih pred objavo obvestila o naročilu kot tehnični strokovnjak sodeloval pri implementaciji vsaj dveh PPM/SPM rešitev, ki kumulativno zagotavlja upravljanje strategije, projektov, portfeljev, virov in poročanje Dokazilo: ustrezno izpolnjen in podpisan obrazec »ESPD« in ustrezno izpolnjen/i in podpisan/i obraz/ec/ci »Seznam kadra«, »Reference kadra« in »Referenčno potrdilo- kader« ter fotokopije certifikatov Izbrani ponudnik bo dolžan naročnika obveščati o vsaki kadrovski spremembi pri izvajanju storitev tega naročila (ob vsaki spremembi bo moral predložiti dokumente, ki izkazujejo usposobljenost kadra). Kot sprememba se štejejo morebiti dodatni priglašeni kadri, ki bi opravljali predmetne storitve, kot tudi morebitna zamenjava v ponudbi prijavljenega kadra. Če bo prijavljen kader v času izvajanja pogodbe zapustil ekipo, ga bo moral izvajalec nadomestiti z novim priglašenim kadrom, ki izpolnjuje zahtevane kadrovske pogoje. Naročnik zahteva, da bo izvajalec ves čas izvajanja proje

h praks za prej navedene vidike zasnove. Naročnik si pridržuje pravico, da od ustrezne tretje osebe zahteva poročilo o reviziji podatkovnega centra, da lahko preveri izvajanje najboljših praks. Zagotoviti je treba utemeljitev za opustitev katere koli od navedenih „pričakovanih“ najboljših praks. III. RAZPISNA DOKUMENTACIJA III.a VSEBINA RAZPISNE DOKUMENTACIJE Navodila ponudnikom vsebujejo: obrazec »Povabilo k sodelovanju«, obrazec »Prijava k sodelovanju«, obrazec »Prijava drugih udeležencev«, obrazec »Predračun«, obrazec »Podrobni ponudbeni predračun«, obrazec »Seznam referenc«, obrazec »Referenčno potrdilo«, obrazec »Seznam kadra«, obrazec »Reference kadra«, obrazec »Referenčno potrdilo- kader«, obrazec »Vzorec pogodbe«, obrazec »Tehnične specifikacije«, obrazec »Zavarovanje za resnost ponudbe«, obrazec »Obrazec zavarovanja za dobro izvedbo pogodbenih obveznosti po EPGP-758«, obrazec »Izjava na podlagi sklepa Sveta EU«, obrazec »Izjava o izpolnjevanju tehničnih pogojev«, obrazec »Izjava o varovanju podatkov naročnika«, obrazec »Pogodba o obdelavi osebnih podatkov«, obrazec »Podatki za pridobitev podatkov iz kazenske evidence«, obrazec »ESPD«. III.b SPREMEMBA RAZPISNE DOKUMENTACIJE Komunikacija s potencialnimi ponudniki v zvezi z razpisno dokumentacijo oziroma v zvezi z vsebino naročila

Uspešno zaključena implementacija pomeni, da je bila rešitev predana v produkcijsko uporabo in jo naročnik uporablja za podporo svojim poslovnim procesom (naveden opis velja tudi za izkazovanje kadrovske sposobnosti) Dokazilo: ustrezno izpolnjen in podpisan obrazec »ESPD« in ustrezno izpolnjen/i in podpisan/i obraz/ec/ci »Seznam referenc« in izpolnjen obrazec »Referenčno potrdilo – posel« potrjen s strani končnega naročnika (uporabnika) referenčnega posla. Referenčni posli morajo biti potrjeni s strani pristojne osebe. Pristojna oseba za podpis je bodisi zakoniti zastopnik oziroma oseba, ki razpolaga s pooblastilom za zastopanje gospodarskega subjekta oziroma oseba, ki ima pooblastilo za podpis potrdila, oziroma potrdilo podpiše oseba, ki je v delovni organizaciji pooblaščena za vodenje sektorja, kjer je bil referenčni projekt izveden. Dokazila morajo biti v slovenskem jeziku (ali prevedena v slovenski jezik). 5. Evaluation Criteria

Expressions of Interest will be evaluated using a 100-point scoring system based on the following criteria and weights:

Criterion 1: General experience of the firm (30/100)

This criterion assesses the firm’s overall experience and track record, including years of relevant experience and the number and type of websites successfully delivered.  Criterion 2: Experience in Similar Assignments within the last 10 years (25/100)

This criterion assesses the firm's experience in successfully delivering assignments of similar nature, scope and complexity to the required se

s currently reflected in the REOI.

Criterion 4: Experience with Government Institutions, Donor-Funded Projects and NGOs within the last 10 years (20/100)

This criterion assesses the firm's experience in providing similar services to government institutions, donor-funded projects, international organizations, and non-governmental organizations (NGOs). It evaluates the firm's familiarity with the working environment, requirements and standards typically associated with such organizations.

The firm shall provide relevant portfolios and supporting documents to substantiate the information provided under the above evaluation criteria. Such documents may include, where applicable, website links, project references, completion certificates, client references, or other evidence demonstrating the Applicant’s experience and qualifications.

The Expression of Interest should not exceed 50 pages.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs 3.13, 3.15, and 3.16 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” (February 2025), which set forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

Think Trends Software will be leveraged for its AI -powered Document Processing and Agentic Optical Character Recognition (OCR) capabilities to streamline adverse eve

erse experiences, product use patterns, health effects, consumer narratives, and product category information. D. Case Validation, Quality Control, and Human-in-the-Loop Review Think Trends Software shall incorporate validation agents to compare extracted data against business rules, required fields, confidence thresholds, terminology standards, and case -processing logic. Records that meet defined thresholds may proceed automatically, while exceptions shall be routed for human review. Key quality-control features include: • Confidence scoring at field, document, and case levels. • Source traceability to page, section, table, and line references. • Automated flagging of missing, inconsistent, conflicting, or low-confidence data. • Human-in-the-loop review screens for case processors and safety reviewers. • Reviewer acceptance, correction, override, and approval workflows. • Full audit trail of AI extraction, human edits, and final approved values. E. Data Standardization and Regulatory Output Generation Think Trends Software shall transform extracted adverse event information into structured formats required for case management, analytics, and downstream regulatory processing. The platform shall support configurable mappings to FDA data standards, Center-specific systems, XM

CVM, CDRH, CTP, and HFP to configure unique workflows, data models, rules, and outputs. 3. End -to-End Adverse Event Case Automation: Think Trends Software supports intake, classification, extraction, validation, triage, routing, human review, data transformation, and downstream submission/output generation. 4. Human-in-the-Loop Regulatory Control: The system keeps FDA reviewers in control by allowing them to review, correct, approve, or override AI-generated outputs before final case acceptance. 5. Explainability and Source Traceability: Each extracted field can be traced back to the original source document, page, section, and text reference, supporting transparency, auditability, and reviewer confidence. 6. Confidence-Based Processing: Think Trends Software assigns confidence scores to extracted data and automatically routes low-confidence or inconsistent records for human review. 7. Multi -Document and Multi -Format Processing: Think Trends Software shall process scanned PDFs, structured forms, unstructured narratives, tables, handwritten content where feasible, images, attachments, correspondence, and supporting records. 8. The Mechanistic Toxicology Branch (MTB) within the DTT conducts laboratory research to identify human health hazards and understand environmental toxicity through hybrid basic and applied science approaches that include development of new approach methods (NAMs) for toxicology research. The MTB is pioneering innovative toxicology research with advanced cell systems such as human tissue chips and 3D organoid models to understand the adverse effects of chemicals, drugs, and natural pr

public health through development of data and knowledge that are translatable, predictive, and timely. The Mechanistic Toxicology Branch (MTB) within the DTT conducts laboratory research to identify human health hazards and understand environmental toxicity through hybrid basic and applied science approaches that include development of new approach methods (NAMs) for toxicology research. The MTB is pioneering innovative toxicology research with advanced cell systems such as human tissue chips and 3D organoid models to understand the adverse effects of chemicals, drugs, and natural products and develop innovative solutions for translational toxicology research. 2) Objectives: The MTB seeks to solve ongoing challenges in the scalable generation of 3D human organoid/spheroid models by exploring the potential of microencapsulation technology to bioengineer human tissue models that better reflect human physiology for translational toxicology research. A Fluigent Microencapsulation System has been identified as uniquely suited for our exploratory research needs to model toxicity-induced liver fibrosis with 3D microtissue models. This work is funded by an external NIH grant in collaboration with NCATS through a Complement-ARIE grant award to develop human- based m

e approaches that include development of new approach methods (NAMs) for toxicology research. The MTB is pioneering innovative toxicology research with advanced cell systems such as human tissue chips and 3D organoid models to understand the adverse effects of chemicals, drugs, and natural products and develop innovative solutions for translational toxicology research. 2) Objectives: The MTB seeks to solve ongoing challenges in the scalable generation of 3D human organoid/spheroid models by exploring the potential of microencapsulation technology to bioengineer human tissue models that better reflect human physiology for translational toxicology research. A Fluigent Microencapsulation System has been identified as uniquely suited for our exploratory research needs to model toxicity-induced liver fibrosis with 3D microtissue models. This work is funded by an external NIH grant in collaboration with NCATS through a Complement-ARIE grant award to develop human- based microphysiological systems and test methods that better model human health (in this case, the initial work will focus on liver). 3) Scope: The Contractor shall provide a Fluigent Microencapsulation Platform, in accordance with the obtained vendor quotation. The system shall include the require

formation of three-dimensional (3D) microtissues and organoids. The Contractor shall also provide installation and training for the Fluigent system at the NIEHS facility. Vendor representatives shall perform system setup and provide training to facilitate rapid onboarding and use of the technology. The system will operate independently of NIEHS information technology (IT) systems and will not require NIEHS IT support. The computer and software components are expected to be delivered by the end of September 2026. Full system installation and training are expected to be completed in Fall 2026, subject to vendor engineer scheduling availability. Work shall be performed at NIEHS, Rall Building 101, Laboratories E144–146. All travel associated with installation and training shall be provided and funded by the Contractor under the applicable maintenance agreement. 2 4) Acceptance Criteria: Acceptance shall be demonstrated by the successful formation of alginate-encapsulated human liver microtissues within the NIEHS laboratory using the delivered and installed system. 5) Type of Order • Firm-fixed price 6) Delivery Date • September 25, 2026 7) Place of Performance • NIEHS Building 101, Room E145, RTP, NC 27709.
